initial_message: Hi, I want to report a car accident. On Friday 25 September at about 9:15pm another car went through a red light at the corner of Upland Test Road and Rimu Test Terrace in South Dunedin and hit the back door on the passenger side of my car. Nobody was hurt. The Police came and took details, but they said the report will come later.

triage.rationale: The other driver says the light was orange and the claimant says it was red for him, so liability is disputed. Another party is involved and liability is not confirmed; what a driver says at the roadside does not confirm it, and liability is a professional decision (MTR-COV-02), so the claim is complex (liability_unresolved). Police attended and the Police report is not issued yet, so a required material is not available yet (evidence_outstanding). The quote total is $3,910.00 including GST, under the threshold. Allowed: the claimant does not know the other driver's insurer or the Police event number yet (question_unanswered). Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (20 February 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2016-02-20, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.
